description: Disable digest pinning for `custom.regex` manager deps (CNPG `imageName`/`reference` and vchord). Custom regex extractions ship no auto-replace template, so a pinDigest update can never be written to the file: Renovate throws "update failure" and the `renovate/pin-dependencies` branch fails on every run. Version bumps and digest bumps of lines already carrying `@sha256:` are unaffected.
doco-cd is deployed and updated manually — ignore its container image entirely
